type.provenance: Proposed law prohibits the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals except under certain conditions.

who.provenance: no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam... unless discharged under either of the following conditions: Such discharge or other use occurs in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation.

action.provenance: Prohibits the discharge or other use of Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals... except under certain conditions.

value: Class B fire fighting foam containing fluorinated organic chemicals
products.provenance: As used in this Part, the following terms have the meaning ascribed to them... (1) 'Class B fire fighting foam' means any foam designed to extinguish flammable liquid fires.

value: Fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation
Training or testing purposes at a facility with containment, treatment, and disposal measures
exceptions.provenance: Such discharge or other use occurs... (1) Such discharge or other use occurs in fire prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation.
